concept.concept: Illustrated overflowing backpack with floating school supplies and the phrase 'Carrying the Weight of Entire Civilization (Unpaid)' for teacher use
concept.audience: Teachers who carry materials to and from classrooms daily
concept.rationale: Teachers literally need large totes for classroom supplies. Functional product meets identity product. August buying window is perfectly timed 6-8 weeks from today.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Carrying the Weight of Entire Civilization (Unpaid)" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of an oversized backpack bursting open with school supplies floating outward in a dynamic composition. Include pencils, books, papers, erasers, and apple scattered around the packed bag. Solid color blocks, no gradients, no airbrush shading, no photorealism. Bold simple shapes with clean sharp edges in a screen-print aesthetic. Limited palette: charcoal gray, warm rust orange, cream white, and forest green on a solid light gray background. Single centered composition with generous margin on all sides. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.text_on_design: Carrying the Weight of Entire Civilization (Unpaid)
design.style: Bold retro sans-serif, all caps, arched above the backpack illustration in charcoal gray

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Carrying the Weight of Entire Civilization (Unpaid)' is an original, descriptive expression of teacher appreciation humor with no known trademark conflicts. It does not reference any brand, character, celebrity, sports team, lyric, or protected slogan. The illustrated backpack and floating school supplies concept is a generic visual theme with no IP-protected elements. The combination is original creative expression suitable for print-on-demand.

image_verdict.reason: The text reads exactly 'CARRYING THE WEIGHT OF ENTIRE CIVILIZATION (UNPAID)' — correctly spelled and complete. The illustration is a clean, original composition of a school backpack overflowing with books, pencils, and school supplies, with an apple at the base. No IP risk, no quality issues, no malformed elements, and a plain background suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Teacher Survival Tote Bag - 'Carrying the Weight' Canvas Bag
listing.description: For teachers who carry the weight of everything. This sturdy canvas tote features an illustrated overflowing backpack with floating school supplies and humorous text celebrating the unpaid labor of educators. Spacious design holds lesson plans, papers, materials, and more. Durable handles built for daily classroom commutes. Witty gift for teachers, perfect for back-to-school season and year-round appreciation.
